changelog: Search Roster supports names in either order, ignores commas, and loads details on the first View click.
Added prominent, theme-aware selected-record and sales-rep banners with click-to-collapse behavior across Records Search, Search Roster, ROE Checker, and Bulk Transfer.
New rep search text clears the previous selection; delayed lookups cannot restore an outdated target. Bulk Transfer confirmation names the destination rep.

Bulk Transfer clears old table results when a new review begins, preserves surname-first employee lookup, allows more time for slow NSCORP responses, and reports lookup IDs accurately without weakening identity checks.
Session Health refreshes every five seconds while the app is visible and when returning to it, without overlapping checks.
Merge Assistant checks all contact pages, supports next/customer edit URLs, and displays Vertical and Industry with warnings for differing verticals.
Improved narrow-screen notices and Merge Review button layout, expanded Territory Changes Summary, and removed hover movement from header utility buttons.
Static Group Creator warns about duplicate names in local Created Groups history, ignoring capitalization and surrounding spaces.
